messages:
ella.ramirez: Heads-up: VegaHealth asked for a 60-90m enablement session focused on Private deployment networking and VPC peering. Theyre in APAC so late-afternoon PT works best for them. Can we pick a slot?

samir.patel: I can do 2026-05-06 17:00 PT (which is early morning APAC). Prefer mon/wed. Ill cover VPC/hybrid connectivity + KMS notes.

toni.white: Im on-call that week but could join the first 30m for runbook overview. If we do 90m, I can co-run the lab.

kevin.cho: Suggest we include a short pre-session video (5min) on our private control plane overview. Cuts live time. Also we should send a pre-req checklist: test VPC, access token, list of attendees + roles.

ella.ramirez: Good call. Proposed slots: 2026-05-06 17:00 PT, 2026-05-08 16:00 PT, 2026-05-13 18:00 PT. React with :one:/:two:/:three:.

samir.patel: :one: from me.

toni.white: :two: works better for my on-call rotation but can do :one: if needed.

kevin.cho: :two: from me. Also adding a doc link for the pre-recorded primer: https://docs.redwood.com/primer/private-control-plane

ops-bot: Draft event created: https://calendar.redwood.com/d/vega-health-ptz-review (status: tentative)

ella.ramirez: Notes from account team: Vega will have 4 infra engineers + security lead. Renewal is Q3; account health flagged "medium" due to networking complexity. We should include a rollback/canary checklist and escalate path.

samir.patel: Ill add a 10-minute segment showing canary rollback steps and run the CLI commands live. Sample snippet in doc:

```
redwoodctl deploy --env private --version v2.1.0 --canary 10%
redwoodctl rollback --env private --to-version v2.0.3
```

kevin.cho: MariaOps asked if we can provide a small test VPC template (CloudFormation/Terraform) they can deploy beforehand. Ill attach a minimal Terraform module to the invite.

toni.white: We should also prepare a short feedback survey to capture confidence level and remaining blockers. Suggest Likert 1-5 plus an open field for blockers.

ella.ramirez: Agreed. Action items: Samir -> draft demo + canary slides; Kevin -> test VPC template + primer link; Toni -> feedback survey + post-workshop follow-up; Ella -> lock date and send invites. If no objections, we pick slot :two: (2026-05-08 16:00 PT).

kevin.cho: No objections. Lock it.

samir.patel: Confirmed. Ill post the lab commands into the shared doc and tag the account team.

ops-bot: Calendar invite sent (confirmed): https://calendar.redwood.com/e/VEGA-5678

ella.ramirez: Invite sent to Vega and internal facilitators. Ive added the pre-req checklist and a short SLA slide on rollback timelines. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
notes: enablement scheduling, pre-req checklist, renewal risk mitigation, canary/rollback demo, feedback survey
